open_issues: KNOWN/RESERVED (review finding 4, unchanged): A05's tree is still the hand-rolled AdminStructureNode with 18px-per-level indentation. It belongs to the shared-WTree design-consistency package, as ruled. A06's office rail has now been moved onto WTree in this round, so only A05's tree pane remains for that package.

ACCEPTED WITH REASON (part of review finding 3): `.a04-template` and `.a04-example` no longer paint a background/border/radius — the WCard they sit in already draws the surface, so page CSS now only arranges. The dark A04 preview boxes the report-template file row and the numbering sample inside the card; I did not reproduce that box because no shared component fits (WDocumentRow is a clickable <button> with no action here and cannot carry the «مدمج» chip or the two WButtons beside the name). If the design owner wants the boxed file row back, it needs a shared 'file row' component added to Wakeel.Design (component + css + gallery entry + bUnit test), which is outside this package's allowed paths.
notes:
All four build/test commands run exactly as given; three builds 0 Warning(s) 0 Error(s), `dotnet test tests/Wakeel.Admin.Tests --no-build` = Failed 0, Passed 165, Total 165. Host run done after the fixes (Wakeel.Admin.exe, port 9334, 1366x768, fresh temp data folder, CDP screenshots at exactly 1366x768, log clean with one INF line, process killed and endpoint confirmed silent).

PER FINDING:

1 (HIGH, locked danger dialog switched off «العودة» too) — FIXED. src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/wwwroot/css/admin.css now scopes the rule to the confirm action only: `.w-dialog--confirm-locked .w-dialog-actions > :first-child .w-btn, .w-dialog--confirm-locked .w-dialog-actions > .w-btn:first-child`. The first selector reaches the confirm through its own tooltip wrapper (WDialog always passes a Tooltip so every button is wrapped); the second covers the unwrapped shape. Measured live on the running host, both dialogs, both themes: A07 «إلغاء الجهاز» before typing → [{«إلغاء الجهاز» pointerEvents none, opacity 0.55, cursor not-allowed}, {«العودة» pointerEvents auto, opacity 1, cursor pointer}]; A04 «تغيير صيغة الترقيم؟» in light → [{«حفظ التغييرات» none/0.55}, {«العودة» auto/1}]. Clicking «العودة» while the dialog is locked actually closes it (verified on the host: 0 dialogs afterwards). New bUnit fact `DangerDialog_SwitchesOffTheMainButtonOnlyAndLeavesTheWayBackAlive` asserts the DOM shape the CSS depends on — the actions row's first child carries the confirm and NOT «العودة», the second child carries «العودة» — and that clicking «العودة» raises OnCancel while locked. (I did not add a `ConfirmDisabled` parameter to WDialog: Wakeel.Design is outside this package's allowed paths.)

2 (MEDIUM, A04 crop slider toast-and-write storm) — FIXED. The range input now carries `@oninput="OnFocusMoved"` and `@onchange="OnFocusSettled"`; `ApplyLogo(bool store)` re-cuts and redraws on every step but only writes `Org.SaveLogo`, re-reads the identity and raises the toast when the slider is released. Verified on the host with a real 600x300 PNG uploaded through the hidden InputFile: 21 slider steps left 0 toasts (and 0 database writes), the release left exactly 1 «حُفظ الشعار.», and the crop visibly moved with the drag.

3 (MEDIUM, hand-rolled offices rail + page-painted surfaces) — FIXED. A06's rail is now `<WTree TItem="AdminOffice">` used at one level (RowOf → Icon "building", Name, Meta = Arabic-Indic device count), with `Selected`/`OnItemSelected` and `EmptyText="@AdminAr.Devices.SearchNothing"` («لا مكتب بهذا الاسم.»). `.a06-list` and every `.a06-office*` rule are deleted; the page stylesheet keeps only a max-height/overflow on the rail so a long list scrolls inside its card. Measured on the host: both rows x 1057, width 262, height 38, the selected row painted by the shared component; search filters and the miss state shows the new text; correct in dark and light. The three remaining page-painted surfaces are also handled: `.a07-subject` (already WKvRows inside) and `.a04-template` / `.a04-example` no longer set background/border/radius — see the open issue for the one visual trade-off on A04.

4 (LOW, A05 tree) — left as the reserved deviation, recorded again in the progress file; A06's rail moved off the hand-rolled shape in this round.

5 (LOW, Arabic gender agreement in Structure log) — FIXED. `AdminAr.Structure.Log.Added/Updated/Disabled/Enabled/Deleted` now take `OrgLevel` instead of a pre-rendered level string and pick the verb form from it (هيئة/دائرة/وحدة feminine, قسم masculine): «أُضيف قسم …» / «أُضيفت دائرة …», and the same for عُدّل/عُدّلت, أُوقف/أُوقفت, حُذف/حُذفت («أُعيد تشغيل» agrees with تشغيل and is unchanged). Callers in AdminStructureService updated. New test `WhatIsWrittenDownAgreesWithTheLayerItIsAbout` builds a real department/section/unit and reads the lines back out of the waiting list. Seen on the running host's A03: «أُضيف قسم «قسم الصادر والوارد».» beside «عُدّلت دائرة «دائرة الشؤون الإدارية».».

6 (LOW, A07 re-signing the revocation list for display) — FIXED. `Reload()` now calls `DeviceKeys.ReadSavedRevocationList()`, so the organisation identity is no longer unsealed on every page open / office change / action, and «وُقّعت في …» shows when the list was really issued. `BuildRevocationList()` is still what Revoke (and A08's export) uses. Verified on the host: after revoking الجهاز ٢ the card shows the device and the signing day, and it survives a full page reload with no new signature.

7 (LOW, COALESCE role/employee defaults in ListDevices) — FIXED. The SELECT no longer defaults anything; it returns `a.role, a.employee_name, a.employee_no, a.sync_scope, a.status` plus `a.device_id IS NOT NULL`, and `AdminDevice` gained `HasAccount` (default true, so no caller breaks). A device with no account row comes back with empty role/scope/status and employee 0, and A06/A07 draw «—» in the employee/role/scope cells and a Warning «سجل ناقص» chip with the tooltip «سُجّل هذا الجهاز دون بيانات موظفه ودوره. أزِله وأعد إضافته.» instead of «مدير المكتب · الموظف ١». New test `ADeviceWhoseEmployeeRecordWasNeverWrittenIsShownAsHalfMadeRatherThanAsAManager` deletes the account row and asserts the half-made shape (and that a whole device still reads whole).

8 (LOW, «آخر تدوير» on a key that was never rotated) — FIXED. `AdminAr.Keys.RotatedOn(at, version)` says «أُصدر في …» while version is 1 and «آخر تدوير …» from 2 onwards. Verified on the host right after the first issue: «أُصدر في ⁧17/09/2026⁩».

9 (LOW, A03 office KPI mixing figure systems) — FIXED. The value is now `AdminAr.Digits(_board.ActivatedOffices)`. On the host the card reads «٠» over «من ٢ · مكتبان بانتظار ملف الإعداد» — one system throughout. (The «1 / 1 / 2» structure KPI stays as expressly accepted in round 1.)

10 (LOW, unbounded decompression of docx parts) — FIXED. `LetterTemplateInspector` gained `MaxPartBytes` (8 MB) and a private `LoadPart(ZipArchiveEntry)` that refuses a part whose declared `entry.Length` is past the limit and also stops the copy at the same limit for a package that understates it, then hands a bounded MemoryStream to `XDocument.Load`. Both refusals throw `InvalidDataException`, which `Inspect` already turns into `LetterTemplateReport.Unreadable` («تعذّرت القراءة»).

SIDE-BY-SIDE (host screenshot beside design/exports/preview/{dark,light}/A, each preview opened once): A06 — same anatomy as the preview, and the rail is now genuinely the preview's shape (building icon + name on one side, count on the far side, primary-soft selected row), office header with path and inventory chip, devices table, banner and «آخر تحديث» foot line; no overlap, no clipping, `.w-table-scroll` 959/959. A07 — key card, revocation list and accounts table aligned as in the preview, and the one visible round-1 deviation is gone: the confirm is dimmed and «تراجع»/«العودة» is at full brightness, exactly as the preview draws it. A04 — same two-by-two grid and full-width template cards; the one deviation from the preview is the unboxed file row and numbering sample (open issue above, accepted with reason). A03 — unchanged apart from the KPI figures.

Nothing outside the allowed paths was touched (verified with `git status --short`); no NuGet package added; no git commit/checkout/stash/reset/clean run.
